output.summary: A fast-growing tree native to the Indian subcontinent and parts of mainland Southeast Asia, neem is evergreen but sheds many leaves during dry winters. It has fragrant white flowers and smooth, olive-like fruits containing bitter-sweet, fibrous pulp.
output.edibilityNote: Tender shoots and flowers are eaten as vegetables in India; young leaves and flower buds are cooked or pickled in Southeast Asia. Neem oil is toxic to small children.
